before.port: One source intake + likely route + explicit downstream handoffs.
before.focus: Optional floating Field Aperture inspector; routing always used whole source.
before.hydration: Source intake restored only through explicit preloads; no exact focus re-entry.

delta: Embedded Field Aperture inline as Port's focus body.
Added WHOLE SOURCE / CURRENT FOCUS route scope.
Added exact lexical cue counts per route; support follows current focus.
Kept zero-support routes visible and selectable.
Separated route SELECT from explicit OPEN.
Stored metadata-only route receipts; no payload text.
Restored source + aperture focus + scope + selected route on same-session re-entry.
Moved completed route preference evidence to OPEN rather than mere route hover/select.
evidence: Field Aperture component is mounted from existing shared component rather than forked.
Route receipt object contains no source text field.
Support is deterministic cue count, not model confidence.
OPEN remains local handoff/navigation; Contact still requires separate Share/Copy for external action.
residue: Cue grammar remains intentionally simple and can be wrong; override is first-class evidence.
Downstream tools do not yet emit a true world RETURN back into Port.
Focus routing of very small units may be inappropriate for some targets; user can switch WHOLE/FOCUS instantly.
next: Use normally. Do not perform a dedicated QA ritual. Let choice/override/backtrack and ordinary re-entry reveal whether focus-routing earns retention.
